ux.mm4b.calendarInfo: Use the arrows to move from one category to another. Only the rounds the chosen category races are listed; the winner is that of its main race. The highlighted round is the next one.
ux.mm4b.levelNote: Level: what your team knows about each rider (as in the market); exact for your own riders.
ux.mm4b.historyNote: The history fills in as each season closes, with the team standings and the riders who raced for the team.
